sources.snippet: Synthyra/ESMFold2-Experimental-Cutoff2025 This checkpoint packages the FastPLMs ESMFold2 implementation. Accepted inputs are raw amino-acid sequences or typed molecular-complex specifications; low-level forward accepts prepared feature tensors. Supported Transformers entry points are AutoConfig, AutoModel.

sources.snippet: ESMFold2 ESMFold2 is the successor to ESMFold that sets a new state of the art for single-sequence structure prediction and enables the generation of new functional proteins through searching the ESMC model's latent space.
